data.long_meaning: The name Sadha signifies truth, reality and the eternal nature of the universe. It is a name that embodies the essence of balance, harmony and stability. The name Sadha is believed to bring prosperity and peace in one's life. The name Sadha carries the meaning “Truth, Reality” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sadha usually hope their child will grow to embody truth, reality and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sadha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Satya' which means truth. In Hinduism, Sadha is considered as a manifestation of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music and arts. The name Sadha signifies the ultimate truth and the divine reality of the universe.
data.etymology: Sadha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truth, Reality.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
